description:
Autosignly is a pay-as-you-go electronic signature and document platform. This connector lets ChatGPT work in Autosignly on your behalf - signed in with your own account and scoped to the company you choose.

With it, chatGPT can:
• browse your companies, document templates and documents (with signing status);
• create templates from HTML and generate documents from them, filling in the template variables;
• send documents for signing with SES, AES or QES (eIDAS-compliant) and track their status.

No API keys to manage — you sign in with your 16it account and chatGPT can only do what you can do. Actions that create documents or send signing invitations ask for your confirmation first, and every action is limited to the company you select.

Prerequisites: a 16it account and at least one company added in Autosignly.

Pricing is pay-as-you-go — pay per generated document and per signature, with no subscription.

defaultPrompt: Show my Autosignly documents that are still waiting for signature, and tell me who hasn't signed yet.
Grab my invoice-terms template, generate the document for this month, and send it to my accountant for signing.
Use my NDA template in Autosignly, fill it in for ACME Corp with today's date, and send it for signing to legal@acme.com.
